comment: Patch art (issue #133, of #131), written by `packbuilder patches` and `packbuilder patch-review`; review on the contact sheets in build/pack-art/<pack id>/patches/. Per species: the reference photo and isolation seed (from art.lock.json, or art.patch.reference), the workflow and patch prompts versions, the setting and any markings it was painted with, the edition's patch, the seed, the cut patch's SHA-256 (its file in <cache>/patches/), the bird's measure against its reference, whether the dark-bird clause was used, and the review: pending, approved (in the pack), rejected (painted again with the next seed by the next run) or gap (no patch; why).
